import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.fft import fft


def task_func(range_start=-10, range_end=10, step=0.1):
    if step == 0:
        raise ValueError("step must be non-zero")

    x_values = np.arange(range_start, range_end, step, dtype=float)

    def generator():
        for x in x_values:
            sin_x = np.sin(x)
            cos_x = np.cos(x)
            yield (x, sin_x, cos_x, abs(sin_x - cos_x))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if x_values.size == 0:
        ax.set_xlabel("x")
        ax.set_ylabel("value")
        ax.set_title("Sine, Cosine, and Absolute Difference")
        ax.legend()
        return generator(), ax, np.nan, np.nan

    sin_values = np.sin(x_values)
    cos_values = np.cos(x_values)
    diff_values = np.abs(sin_values - cos_values)

    ax.plot(x_values, sin_values, label="sin(x)")
    ax.plot(x_values, cos_values, label="cos(x)")
    ax.plot(x_values, diff_values, label="abs(sin(x) - cos(x))")

    ax.set_xlabel("x")
    ax.set_ylabel("value")
    ax.set_title("Sine, Cosine, and Absolute Difference")
    ax.legend()

    fft_values = fft(diff_values)
    mean_fft_magnitude = abs(np.mean(fft_values))
    median_fft_magnitude = abs(np.median(fft_values))

    return generator(), ax, mean_fft_magnitude, median_fft_magnitude
